issue.title: 36 ACE PNG goldens fail just test-visual on master: standing rebaseline backlog from recent UI landings
issue.description:
PROPOSED BY phase bead sase-qv.4 (epic sase-qv, "Required custom monitor statuses with
deterministic pair colors") on 2026-08-19T17:23:28Z, re-measured and routed here by that
epic's land agent. NOT caused by sase-qv: that epic's only visual surfaces are the two
monitor goldens, and both pass (see RESOLVED note on sase-q1).

`just test-visual` on master at HEAD be6077c7f is red with 37 failed / 693 passed / 1
skipped (31m22s). One of those 37 was epic sase-qv's own stale golden
(agents_family_conversation_monitor_120x40) and the land agent regenerated it as epic
work. The remaining 36 are stale goldens left by other recently-landed UI work, and none
of them touch monitor rendering:

  footer / leader (2) -- test_ace_png_snapshots.py::test_footer_leader_overflow_wide,
    ::test_footer_leader_overflow_narrow
  agents slow tools (1) --
    test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_slow_tools.py::test_agents_slow_tool_calls_fold_levels_png_snapshots
  artifacts beads (4) -- test_ace_png_snapshots_artifacts_beads.py::test_artifacts_beads_populated_png_snapshot,
    ::test_artifacts_beads_collapsed_relations_rail_png_snapshot,
    test_ace_png_snapshots_artifacts_beads_empty.py::test_artifacts_beads_empty_png_snapshot,
    test_ace_png_snapshots_artifacts_beads_reopened.py::test_artifacts_beads_reopened_detail_png_snapshot
  artifacts files (2) -- test_ace_png_snapshots_artifacts_files.py::test_artifacts_files_populated_png_snapshot,
    test_ace_png_snapshots_artifacts_files_empty.py::test_artifacts_files_empty_png_snapshot
  artifacts split (4) -- test_ace_png_snapshots_artifacts_split.py::test_artifacts_split_mode_png_snapshot
    [narrow-size0 / even-size1 / wide-size2 / narrow-size3]
  at-reference (2) -- test_ace_png_snapshots_at_reference_completion.py::test_fuzzy_at_reference_payload_panel_png_snapshot,
    ::test_truncated_at_reference_payload_panel_png_snapshot
  AXE editor (5) -- test_ace_png_snapshots_axe_editor.py::test_axe_add_chooser_png_snapshot,
    ::test_axe_script_picker_png_snapshot, ::test_axe_new_lumberjack_identity_png_snapshot,
    ::test_axe_editor_constrained_width_png_snapshot, ::test_axe_editor_compact_lumberjack_sheet_png_snapshot
  AXE layout (1) -- test_ace_png_snapshots_axe_layout.py::test_axe_constrained_width_no_wrap_png_snapshot
  copy-as palette (2) -- test_ace_png_snapshots_copy_as_palette.py::test_copy_as_stitches_selected_dark_png_snapshot,
    ::test_copy_as_over_artifact_files_modal_png_snapshot
  glossary (8) -- test_ace_png_snapshots_glossary_panel.py::test_glossary_panel_populated_png_snapshot[dark|light],
    ::test_glossary_panel_empty_png_snapshot[dark|light],
    test_ace_png_snapshots_glossary_preview.py::test_glossary_preview_card_full_png_snapshot[dark|light],
    ::test_glossary_preview_card_minimal_png_snapshot, ::test_repo_preview_card_png_snapshot
  help panel (1) -- test_ace_png_snapshots_help_panel.py::test_help_panel_keymaps_png_snapshot
  notification report (1) -- test_ace_png_snapshots_notification_report.py::test_notification_report_modal_png_snapshot
  plan toast (2) -- test_ace_png_snapshots_plan_toast.py::test_epic_plan_toast_png_snapshot,
    ::test_tale_plan_toast_png_snapshot
  prompt stack (1) -- test_ace_png_snapshots_prompt_stack.py::test_prompt_stack_g_prefix_hints_png_snapshot

LIKELY SOURCES (correlate before rebaselining, do not blanket-accept): the footer,
help-panel, and prompt g-prefix goldens line up with the new leader/prompt bindings
landed by d4f6535c4 (,L jump_to_last_error) and b419802f3 (prompt gm / Ctrl+G m Memory
panel); the artifacts beads/files/split and filter-bar-adjacent modals line up with
c9cb183c4 (shared FilterBar idle chrome adopted on Commit/Patch bars) and 1a0d8e867
(persistent BeadFilterBar/FileFilterBar); the glossary goldens line up with 5057a264e
(`sase glossary all`) and cdf58ac00 (glossary-read reports from GLOSSARY hints).

WHY THIS MATTERS: `just test-visual` is not part of `just check` or `just check-full`,
so this does not gate landings -- which is exactly why it has accumulated. With 36
unexplained reds, the next agent who adds a UI feature cannot tell its own drift from
the standing backlog, and the documented workflow (inspect .pytest_cache/sase-visual/
artifacts, then accept with --sase-update-visual-snapshots) becomes unusable.

SCOPE: for each group, attribute the diff to the commit that changed the rendering,
confirm the new frame is the intended appearance (read the diff.png / actual.png, do not
trust the byte count), then regenerate that group's goldens only. Do NOT run
`just test-visual-update` across the whole suite -- closed task sase-lo records that it
silently absorbs unrelated drift. `just test-visual -- <node-id> --sase-update-visual-snapshots`
is the scoped form and is what the sase-qv land agent used for the one monitor golden.
Several of these nodes already have their own beads with a diagnosed root cause that is
NOT simple staleness; check them before rebaselining (see RELATED notes).

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic, not intermittent. All 37 nodes failed in one serial single-worker visual lane run (pytest -n 1, 31m22s) with content-scale diffs, not sub-pixel renderer noise: the sase-qv-owned golden this landing then fixed showed 94194/1520532 changed pixels (6.19%) with max_diff_ratio 0.0, and its diff.png was an exact, explainable text/style change (family container row gained the pair accent and the completed glyph). The visual fixtures pin color and fontconfig/Fira Code specifically so this lane is deterministic, and local runs use exact pixel equality. Several of the same node IDs already have standing beads from earlier runs on earlier trees (sase-ol, sase-os, sase-ph, sase-pu), which is direct evidence the failures persist across runs rather than flaking.

RELATED: sase-lo — closed: just test-visual-update rewrites every PNG golden in the suite, silently absorbing unrelated drift. That is why this bead's scope insists on per-node scoped updates.
RELATED: sase-ny — closed precedent: 'Rebaseline 7 stale ACE PNG goldens left by landed UI changes'. Same task shape at a smaller scale; read its close note for the attribution workflow that worked.

SCOPE NOTE FOR WHOEVER WORKS THIS: worth pinning down what changed in the rasterization stack between 2026-08-21 and 2026-08-23 before rebaselining 363 goldens, otherwise the rebaseline just re-pins whichever renderer the accepting agent happened to run. Independent reproduction on 2026-08-26 at HEAD 8d074c8dd (clean tree) while landing epic
sase-u6.5, proposed by phase bead sase-u6.5.2. Adds the ROOT CAUSE and the exact scope
behind the symptom 0e6 sampled on this same day ("navigation waits expecting
artifacts_subtab='patches' after page.press('2') while the app remained on 'stitches'").

(1) THAT SYMPTOM IS NOT A STALE GOLDEN AND WILL NOT REBASELINE AWAY. Commit 4dd299502
("feat(artifacts): put agents first in subtabs") reordered the Artifacts sub-tab strip
from Stitch/Patch/Bead/Plan/Agent/File to Agent/Stitch/Patch/Bead/Plan/File. It updated
only five visual modules (artifacts_beads, artifacts_beads_empty,
artifacts_beads_reopened, artifacts_files_view, artifacts_split) plus a handful of
non-visual suites. A static scan of tests/ for `press("<digit>")` followed within four
lines by `expect_state("artifacts_subtab", ...)` finds 261 sites across 73 files whose
digit no longer maps to the asserted sub-tab. Those nodes fail at the navigation
assertion BEFORE any image comparison, so `--sase-update-visual-snapshots` cannot repair
them and their golden is never even read. Confirmed end to end on
tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_changespecs_onboarding.py (both nodes):
"AssertionError: expect_state('artifacts_subtab', 'patches') timed out after 5.0s — last
value was 'stitches'". Repairing this class means remapping the key press per site
(Agent=1, Stitch=2, Patch=3, Bead=4, Plan=5, File=6), then rebaselining.

(2) 25 GOLDENS OUTSIDE THE artifacts_* FILENAME PREFIX NOW ALSO CARRY EPIC sase-u6's
PANE-BRIEF ROW. sase-u6 added a default one-row Artifacts pane brief under the sub-tab
strip. Its own phases repaired every golden named artifacts_* (34 in 2cbe2f17d, 11 in
8d074c8dd), and all 45 artifacts-family visual nodes pass exactly at this HEAD. But the
brief also renders behind modals and panels whose goldens are named otherwise, and all
of those were last rebaselined by pre-epic commit e8de34fe0. Scanning every actual.svg
under .pytest_cache/sase-visual/ for the six default pane summaries finds these 25
already-red goldens now rendering a brief row their expected image does not have:
